definitions.explanation: A matter or incident that requires attention or is under consideration, especially in legal, administrative, or official contexts.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧{事案|じあん}⟦について→〜について：03103_nitsuite⟧⟦{調査|ちょうさ}→調査：03489_chousa⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧。
⟦{個人情報|こじんじょうほう}→個人情報：18842_kojinjouhou⟧⟦{漏洩|ろうえい}→漏洩：09150_rouei⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{事案|じあん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{発生|はっせい}した→発生する：25529_hasseisuru⟧。
examples.english: A personal data breach incident occurred.

examples.japanese: ⟦{過去|かこ}→過去：00152_kako⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{類似|るいじ}→類似：14672_ruiji⟧{事案|じあん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{参考|さんこう}→参考：02828_sankou⟧にして⟦{対応|たいおう}→対応：02510_taiou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{決|き}める→決める：00858_kimeru⟧。
examples.english: We will decide on our response by referring to similar past cases.

notes:
A formal word for 'case' or 'matter,' commonly used in legal, government, business, and news contexts. It often implies a problem, incident, or issue that needs to be addressed. In recent years, it has also spread into informal internet slang — for example, {事案|じあん} is sometimes used humorously online to describe minor everyday incidents as if they were serious official cases.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {事案|じあん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{発生|はっせい}する→発生する：25529_hasseisuru⟧: an incident occurs
- ⟦{重大|じゅうだい}→重大：01641_juudai⟧{事案|じあん}: serious matter/case
- {不祥事|ふしょうじ}{事案|じあん}: misconduct case
- ⟦{類似|るいじ}→類似：14672_ruiji⟧{事案|じあん}: similar case
- ⟦{個別|こべつ}→個別：11566_kobetsu⟧{事案|じあん}: individual case

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{事件|じけん}→事件：01568_jiken⟧: incident, case — broader and more commonly used; often implies criminal activity
- ⟦{案件|あんけん}→案件：13109_anken⟧: matter, case — very similar; more often used for projects or tasks under consideration
- ⟦{問題|もんだい}→問題：00797_mondai⟧: problem, issue — more general, less formal
